title: GOBLIIINS
subtitle: Coktel Vision, 1991 · the demo, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007): its Gob engine
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its id. Other switches: -g<scaler> (1x, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects, -z the games each engine knows.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: gob1-dos-demo1-en/files/ from gob1-dos-demo1-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

controls: pick a goblin at the bottom, then where it goes or what it uses
_why: The first of 0.10.0's engines beyond SCUMM, Sky and Queen held to a native g++ build frame by frame (gate-scummvm010, 3,000 frames). It found a C++ defect: a static member array declared [] kept size 0 after its definition.
